goal: Fail closed before provider mutations when an AccountRuntime was built from an obsolete proxy-control generation. Add one central runtime-generation guard and apply it to server mutation egress checks and direct SSH-key mutations.
context: Phase 2 already prevents stale passive observations from mutating proxy health. The authoritative current generation is persisted in proxy_runtime_state; there is no authoritative in-memory current-generation registry. Phase 3 may perform one proxycontrol generation lookup at the provider mutation guard boundary, but MUST NOT add a lookup per HTTP request. Direct-mode runtimes with generation 0 remain unaffected. Proxy-required runtime mismatch, missing row, or store error must block mutation. Cover workflow/lifecycle server mutations and direct SSH-key create/delete paths with focused tests. Do not invent a new generation registry, redesign drivers, proxy rotation, circuit policy, schema, or Vultr semantics.

implement: gofmt -w internal/app/container.go internal/app/workflow.go internal/app/lifecycle.go internal/app/ssh_identity.go internal/app/recovery.go internal/app/provider_network_runtime_test.go

commit_message: feat(proxy): block mutations from stale provider runtimes
